input: Learn to read a stock options chain

gold.taskTitle: Learn to Read a Stock Options Chain
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to develop the ability to read and interpret a stock options chain.

questions.title: What is your current knowledge level of stock options?
questions.description: Understand whether the user is a complete beginner, has basic awareness, or has some hands-on experience with options.

questions.title: Which platform or broker will you view options chains on?
questions.description: Identify the specific platform (e.g., Thinkorswim, Robinhood, Webull, Tastytrade) so guidance can be tailored to its layout.

questions.title: Is your goal to trade options or just understand them?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user intends to actively place options trades or simply wants to read chains for informational or analytical purposes.

questions.title: Which specific columns or terms confuse you most?
questions.description: Pinpoint exactly which elements of the chain (e.g., delta, implied volatility, open interest, bid/ask spread) are unclear to the user.

questions.title: Are you focused on calls, puts, or both?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants to understand one side of the options chain or the full picture including both calls and puts.

questions.title: Do you have a specific stock or sector in mind to practice with?
questions.description: Find out if the user wants to learn using a real example they already follow, such as a particular ticker or industry.

questions.title: What is your target timeline to feel confident doing this?
questions.description: Establish a deadline or timeframe the user has in mind so the plan can be paced appropriately.
